requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so energy classes A1 through C are accepted.
User wants the building located near public transport. Value set to the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).
A university student residence clearly needs nearby education services (schools/universities). Value set to the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75).

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The 60-person capacity is not converted to an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. The planned student-residence use is a future use and does not affect the current typology.

output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (Uffici e assimilabili) with surface_area >= 850 m², within 3.0 km of the given coordinates, energy class A1–C, mobility >= 71 and education >= 75. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the coordinates, nearest first. No LIMIT is applied.
